faq.title: Frequently asked questions about AI and esports predictions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about our Machine Learning algorithm, covered LoL competitions, and our value bet approach.

items.a: Unlike sites based on subjective opinions, our predictions are generated by an advanced AI engine. We use Machine Learning models (LightGBM, Voting Ensemble) trained on 10 years of competitive data (KDA, GPM, vision, drafts, win rates per patch). Our algorithm processes thousands of variables in real time to calculate objective, data-driven win probabilities.

items.q: Which LoL competitions do you cover?
items.a: We cover the world elite of League of Legends. Our algorithmic analyses include major leagues (LEC, LCK, LPL, LCS) as well as minor leagues (LFL, Arabian, etc.) and international tournaments (Worlds, MSI). Our model adapts to the specifics of each region.

No. Esports betting always carries randomness (the 'human factor'). PredictEsport provides decision support based on statistical probabilities to maximize your long-term Expected Value (EV). We recommend always betting responsibly.

items.q: What's the difference between a tip and an AI prediction?
items.a: A classic tip is often someone's opinion. A PredictEsport prediction is the result of a mathematical probability calculation. Our model quantifies uncertainty and identifies value bets (odds underestimated by bookmakers) rather than just guessing the winner.

valueBet.title: What is a "value bet"?
valueBet.intro: A value bet is simply an opportunity where the odds offered by the bookmaker are higher than the true probability you calculate (or our algorithm calculates for you).
valueBet.formula: If the offered odds are greater than 1 / Estimated probability, then you have a value bet!

example.scenario: Let's take a fictional Worlds 2025 match:
example.bookmaker: The bookmaker gives odds of 2.20 for T1 to win.
example.algorithm: Our algorithm estimates T1 has a 50% chance of winning (real probability = 0.50).
example.calculation: If T1 has a 50% chance of winning, the "fair odds" should be:
example.conclusion: So here, the offered odds (2.20) are higher than the fair odds (2.00) → This is a value bet!
example.explanation: By betting on T1 at 2.20, you're in a favorable position in the long run, as the odds overestimate your potential winnings compared to the real risk.

story.title: Our story
story.text1: PredictEsport was born from a shared passion for esports and data science. As a long-time fan of League of Legends and other competitive games, I've always been fascinated by the strategic complexity of these matches.
story.text2: With expertise in data analysis and machine learning, I decided to create a tool that would allow fans and bettors to make more informed decisions. Our algorithm analyzes thousands of match data points to identify trends and predict results with impressive accuracy.
story.text3: Our mission is simple: make esports analysis accessible to everyone and help our community better understand the game they love.
story.text4: Also, I peaked Master 400 LP in Season 15 EUW with my main Shaco. Which explains the Shaco pictures when I don't have the team's photo ;)
